description.value:
The ‘Winding Internal Process Crossbow’ is a remarkably older design from Everest Ventureware, whose market share of arrow-based weaponry has greatly diminished in recent years. Nevertheless, the WIP remains unique, as all of its mechanics are held within a more traditional firearm-style casing, and uses a custom dual-layer magazine. Thus, the WIP can double up its workload to make twice the impact to your target’s sleep schedule.

Cost: 750eb (Expensive)

Class: Crossbow • Skill: Archery • Range: Shortbow

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 8 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Extended Magazine, Infrared Nightvision Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: When firing this weapon, the user may choose to expend an additional round. When done, if the weapon would then ablate armor, it ablates 1 additional SP (2 SP Normal / 3 SP Armor Piercing). This weapon’s Extended Magazine cannot be removed or replaced without destroying the weapon beyond repair. This weapon can only fire arrows feeded from its Extended Magazine, and thus cannot manually load Arrows. When the Extended Magazine is depleted, this weapon cannot fire until the magazine is refilled with a Reload Action.

Range: Shortbow
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Infrared Nightvision Scope (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
